name: Acid Vat
Traits and Special Powers: EFFECT:At the beginning of your turn, deal an opposing character occupying one or more of Acid Vat's squares one penetrating damage. // When Acid Vat is destroyed by an opposing character, after resolutions deal that character one unavoidable damage.

name: Glue Trap
Traits and Special Powers: EFFECT:Opposing characters that move into this marker's squares stop moving, and opposing characters occupying this marker must break away to move. // When an opposing character destroys this marker, after resolutions give them an action token, and they modify defense -1 until they clear action tokens.

name: Jack in the Box
Traits and Special Powers: EFFECT:At the beginning of your turn, knock back an opposing character occupying this marker in any direction. // When Jack in the Box is destroyed by an opposing character, after resolutions you may knock that character back 6 squares in any direction.

name: Catapult
Traits and Special Powers: EFFECT:If this terrain is on the map, at the beginning of your turn you may place a character occupying it up to 4 squares away from their current square.

name: Zap Trap
Traits and Special Powers: EFFECT:At the beginning of your turn, give an action token to all characters occupying this marker. If they can't be given an action token, deal them 1 unavoidable damage. // When an opposing character destroys this marker, after resolutions deal 1 unavoidable damage to opposing characters that were occupying or adjacent to the destroyed terrain.

name: Security Camera
Traits and Special Powers: EFFECT:When a character would draw line of fire to a character within 3 squares of Security Camera, they may draw it from Security Camera's square.

name: Throne
Traits and Special Powers: EFFECT:Friendly characters with the Ruler keyword occupying this terrain increase their single d6 rolls by +1. If they also occupy elevated terrain, they treat friendly characters within 4 squares as adjacent when using Leadership and Mastermind.

name: Secret Entrance [2]
Traits and Special Powers: EFFECT:Immobile. When a character moves into an adjacent square, they may choose to immediately place themselves adjacent to a Secret Entrance [1] within 3 squares of this marker. If they do, they end their movement.

name: Weight Bench
Traits and Special Powers: EFFECT:Powers: Super StrengthCharacters occupying the marker have "POWER: Give this character a Gains token. This game they can use Super Strength."

name: Weight Rack
Traits and Special Powers: EFFECT:When this marker starts the game, generate 6 standard objects in its square.

name: Life Model Decoy
Traits and Special Powers: EFFECT:When a friendly character would be hit, you may choose a character on your force that shares a name with that character. If you do, place both characters in each others' squares and the chosen character becomes the hit target instead.

name: Eegro the Unbreakable
Traits and Special Powers: EFFECT:When an opposing character destroys a terrain marker, after resolutions you may generate an Eegro bystander adjacent to that character.

name: Eegro
Traits and Special Powers: [Damage] ULTIMATE ATTACKPOWER: This game Eegro has [cs:colossal] and modifies his combat values +1. Protected: Outwit, Pulse Wave.

name: Transquilizer Blaster
Traits and Special Powers: EFFECT:When a friendly character gives an opposing character an action token, you may choose that that opposing character modifies defense -2 this turn.

name: Superhuman Registration Act
Traits and Special Powers: EFFECT:When an opposing character uses Leadership and succeeds, you may have that opponent choose one:*That player's force has Action Total -2 this turn.*You may give up to two characters friendly to that character an action token.

name: Raft Breakout
Traits and Special Powers: EFFECT:At the beginning of your turn, if at least 3 characters are in your KO area, you may generate two [set:tb] #005 Raft Escapees on click #1 into any squares either in your starting area or containing debris markers.

name: Redemption
Traits and Special Powers: EFFECT:When a friendly character would be the single target of an attack, you may place another friendly character adjacent to them. If you do, the placed character becomes the only target of that attack (even if they would be an illegal target).

name: Betrayal
Traits and Special Powers: EFFECT:At the beginning of your turn, you may remove all action tokens from an opposing character. If at least 1 action token is removed this way, you may remove an action token from a friendly character and heal them 1 click.

name: Contessa's Scheme
Traits and Special Powers: EFFECT:When a friendly character uses Shape Change, before rolling they may choose to increase the d6 roll by +1. If they do and that Shape Change roll fails, after resolutions deal the attacker 1 penetrating damage.

name: Fixer's Blueprint
Traits and Special Powers: EFFECT:When a friendly character destroys an opposing terrain marker, after resolutions they may generate and equip an equipment of 10 points or less from your Sideline.

name: Ultron's Blueprint
Traits and Special Powers: EFFECT:When an opposing character that's equipped or has the Armor, Robot, or Vehicle keyword is KO'd, after resolutions you may generate a [set:tb] #007 Ultron Drone on its red starting line in the square that character last occupied.

name: Doom's Blueprint
Traits and Special Powers: EFFECT:When a friendly character uses Leadership and rolls a [d:6], after resolutions that character may generate a [set:tb] #008 Doombot on its red starting line.

name: Kobik's Help
Traits and Special Powers: EFFECT:At the end of your turn, you may choose a friendly character and any number of friendly characters adjacent to them. Place one of the chosen characters up to 3 squares away from their current square, then place the other chosen characters adjacent to them.

name: Shield Throw
Traits and Special Powers: EFFECT:Equipped friendly characters have "RANGE: [cs:bolt][cs:bolt][cs:bolt]. Make a range attack with a minimum range of 4. Instead of normal damage, deal each hit character 3 damage." (Turn this face down the first time a character uses this effect.)

name: Fortify
Traits and Special Powers: EFFECT:When a friendly character would take 4 or more damage (after reducers), you may have them take 1 damage instead.

name: Zemo's Scheme
Traits and Special Powers: EFFECT:When a friendly character rolls a single d6, before rolling you may choose to increase the result of that roll by +1.

name: Book of Zemo
Traits and Special Powers: EFFECT:When a friendly character with the Past keyword uses Probability Control, you may choose that they have a minimum range of 6 and [it:characters].
